raw_html: [[Peals of Thunder]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Peals of Thunder]]:''' This weapon is filled with the power of a storm cloud. Occasionally, this thunderous power is unleashed, applying a lasting effect that deals 2 to 8 sonic damage every two seconds for six seconds. If the effect is reapplied before it wears off, the effect will stack and the duration will reset. The effect can be stacked up to 3 times.
